title: Design System: Heiyuki — Scenario Broadcast Crawl

display.purpose: HEIYUKI bug, densest condensed tracking for channel identity.

headline.purpose: Greenroom and Lobby page titles (uppercase condensed).

label.purpose: Field labels, meter labels, button text, seat labels.

shadows.name: meter-charge
shadows.purpose: Filled Life segments; amber variant for Shield.

motion.name: ease-chrome
motion.purpose: Button, offer, and loadout border/background state changes.

motion.name: crawl-marquee
motion.purpose: Scenario crawl scroll; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary CTA Button
components.description: Amber lamp CTA for Create Session, Start Match, Confirm, Request to join.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { border: 1px solid var(--amber, #f0c878); border-radius: 2px; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; padding: 8px 14px; background: color-mix(in srgb, #f0c878 14%, #0b101a); color: #f0c878; transition: background 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: color-mix(in srgb, #f0c878 22%, #0b101a); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5eb8ff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Secondary console action on panel-lift with phosphor border.
components.css: .ds-btn-default { border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #5eb8ff 60%, transparent); border-radius: 2px; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; padding: 8px 14px; background: #101522; color: #e8eef4; transition: background 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-default:hover:not(:disabled) { background: color-mix(in srgb, #5eb8ff 8%, #101522); } .ds-btn-default:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5eb8ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Low-emphasis action with soft phosphor border and ice-dim text.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #5eb8ff 50%, transparent); border-radius: 2px; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; padding: 8px 14px; background: #101522; color: #9aacbf; transition: background 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover:not(:disabled) { color: #e8eef4; border-color: color-mix(in srgb, #5eb8ff 60%, transparent); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5eb8ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Phosphor-labeled field for Session title and similar greenroom inputs.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 12px; font-family: 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field__label { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #5eb8ff; } .ds-field__input { padding: 8px 10px; border-radius: 2px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #5eb8ff 60%, transparent); background: #101522; color: #e8eef4; font: inherit; } .ds-field__input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5eb8ff; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Broadcast Panel
components.description: L-bracketed channel panel used on Home, Join, Lobby, and seat windows.
components.html:
Create Session

Sign in to create a Session or join with a join link.
components.css: .ds-panel { position: relative; padding: 14px 16px; background: #0b101a; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #5eb8ff 60%, transparent); color: #9aacbf; font-family: 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel::before, .ds-panel::after { content: ''; position: absolute; width: 10px; height: 10px; border-color: #5eb8ff; border-style: solid; pointer-events: none; } .ds-panel::before { top: -1px; left: -1px; border-width: 2px 0 0 2px; } .ds-panel::after { bottom: -1px; right: -1px; border-width: 0 2px 2px 0; } .ds-panel__title { margin: 0 0 12px; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #e8eef4; } .ds-panel__body { margin: 0; font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.45; }

components.name: Offer Tag
components.description: Uppercase mode/effect/rarity tag on Boon offer rows.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; font-family: 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 2px 6px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #5eb8ff 45%, transparent); color: #9aacbf; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; }

components.name: Channel Header
components.description: Three-zone channel bug header with phase line, session chip, and optional ON AIR lamp.
components.html:
HEIYUKIMAIN SCENARIO — GREENROOM
CHANNEL 07090E
ON AIR
components.css: .ds-channel-header { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #5eb8ff 60%, transparent); background: color-mix(in srgb, #0b101a 80%, #07090e); font-family: 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-channel-header__brand { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px; min-width: 0; } .ds-channel-bug { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.12em; color: #e8eef4; text-decoration: none; } .ds-channel-bug:hover { color: #5eb8ff; } .ds-channel-bug:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5eb8ff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-channel-header__phase { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: #5eb8ff; } .ds-channel-header__session { font-size: 0.78rem; color: #9aacbf; text-align: center; } .ds-channel-header__status { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; } .ds-on-air { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.14em; color: #f0c878; } .ds-on-air__lamp { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #f0c878; box-shadow: 0 0 8px color-mix(in srgb, #f0c878 70%, transparent); }

components.name: Scenario Crawl
components.description: Docked lower-third crawl with amber accent items and pipe dividers.
components.html: HEIYUKI|JOIN A SESSION|WATCH THE AUTO-FIGHT
components.css: .ds-crawl { border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #5eb8ff 60%, transparent); background: #0b101a; overflow: hidden; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #9aacbf; } .ds-crawl__track { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; padding: 8px 16px; gap: 0; } .ds-crawl__item { display: inline-flex; padding: 0 16px; } .ds-crawl__item--accent { color: #f0c878; } .ds-crawl__divider { color: color-mix(in srgb, #5eb8ff 60%, transparent); padding: 0 4px; }

components.name: Segmented Meter
components.description: Life/Shield instrument: condensed label, discrete segments, tabular value.
components.html:
Life
12 / 20
components.css: .ds-meter { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 3.5rem 1fr auto; gap: 8px; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 0.78rem; font-family: 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-meter__label { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #5eb8ff; } .ds-meter__track { display: flex; gap: 2px; height: 10px; } .ds-meter__seg { flex: 1 1 0; min-width: 0; background: color-mix(in srgb, #5eb8ff 12%, #101522); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #5eb8ff 18%, transparent); } .ds-meter__seg--filled { background: #5eb8ff; border-color: #5eb8ff; box-shadow: 0 0 4px color-mix(in srgb, #5eb8ff 40%, transparent); } .ds-meter__value { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: #e8eef4; font-size: 0.72rem; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Numbered SELECT Offer
components.description: Center-column Weapon/Boon pick as a numbered system box.
components.css: .ds-offer { width: 100%; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2rem 1fr; gap: 10px; align-items: start; text-align: left; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #5eb8ff 60%, transparent); padding: 12px 14px; background: #101522; color: #9aacbf; font-family: 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-offer:hover:not(:disabled) { background: color-mix(in srgb, #5eb8ff 8%, #101522); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, #5eb8ff 40%, color-mix(in srgb, #5eb8ff 60%, transparent)); } .ds-offer:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5eb8ff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-offer__num { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.4rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; color: #5eb8ff; } .ds-offer__body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; min-width: 0; } .ds-offer__god { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #5eb8ff; } .ds-offer__name { font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.95rem; color: #e8eef4; } .ds-offer__detail { font-size: 0.82rem; line-height: 1.4; }

narrative.overview:
Heiyuki reads as one on-air Scenario channel end to end. Home, Join, Lobby, and Match share the same matte black ground, phosphor system chrome, amber alert lamps, and ice typography — not a Match-only skin over a light lobby shell. The memorable frame is the dual-seat stage: West seat window, center SELECT stack, East seat window, with a condensed phosphor crawl docked at the bottom.

Density is instrument-panel tight: numbered offer rows, segmented Life/Shield meters, channel-bug headers, and L-bracketed panels. Greek gods stay first-class on Boon offers (name + seal treatment), never as pottery chrome or a TFT shop HUD. Depth comes from tonal panel lifts and phosphor border mixes, not soft card shadows.
keyCharacteristics: Whole-app channel continuity (header bug + crawl + panel grammar everywhere)
ORV system blue phosphor for system chrome; amber reserved for lamps and CTAs
Coral reserved for fight-hit flash only
Condensed broadcast caps (Barlow Condensed) + quiet UI grotesk (Barlow)
Segmented meters and numbered SELECT offers as signature instruments

rules.name: The Coral Hit-Only Rule
rules.body: Coral appears only as fight-hit flash on loadout slots. Errors use ice text on a faint coral-tinted panel wash — never coral fills as buttons.

rules.name: The Amber Lamp Rule
rules.body: Amber is for ON AIR lamps, CTA borders/fills, crawl accent items, and gold/verdict emphasis. Phosphor owns everyday system chrome.

rules.name: The Phosphor Chrome Rule
rules.body: If it is a border, focus ring, meter segment, channel label, or SELECT index number, it is phosphor (or a phosphor mix) unless rarity or amber lamp applies.

rules.name: The Condensed Caps Rule
rules.body: Channel chrome, buttons, labels, and crawl are Barlow Condensed uppercase with open tracking. Do not use Cinzel, Inter, Space Grotesk, Fraunces, or serif “museum” display faces.

rules.name: The Quiet Body Rule
rules.body: Body stays Barlow at ice-dim; display condensed does the shouting so the stage does not fill with competing headlines.

rules.name: The Dual-Seat Stage Rule
rules.body: Match composition is West seat | SELECT center | East seat under one channel header, crawl docked bottom. Do not collapse into a shop grid or circular tondo arena.

rules.name: The Flat Console Rule
rules.body: No ambient card shadows. Depth is panel lift + phosphor border; glow means “on air” or “hit,” not decoration.

rules.name: The Bracket Panel Rule
rules.body: Recurring containers use .broadcast-panel grammar: panel fill, strong phosphor border, L-brackets on opposite corners. Do not invent kylix rim shells, elliptical tondos, or frieze class names.

rules.name: The No-Pill Rule
rules.body: Capsules and large radii are out. Interactive chrome stays 2px; lamps alone are round.

rules.name: The Numbered SELECT Rule
rules.body: Weapon and Boon picks are a vertical stack of numbered system boxes in the center column — not a bordered card grid or shop carousel.

rules.name: The Segmented Instrument Rule
rules.body: Life and Shield read as discrete phosphor/amber segments, not a single smooth bar fill.

dos: Do keep Home, Join, Lobby, and Match on the same ground/panel/phosphor/amber token set and channel header + crawl grammar.
Do reserve amber for lamps and CTAs; phosphor for everyday chrome.
Do use Barlow Condensed uppercase for channel chrome and Barlow for body.
Do build panels with L-brackets and 2px interactive chrome.
Do flash fight hits with coral only; keep god names first-class on Boon offers.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion (static crawl, no offer/slot transition).
donts: Don't revive Kylix Tondo Arena tokens, Cinzel/Source Sans, rim shells, friezes, or elliptical tondos.
Don't use coral as a general accent (buttons, links, idle borders).
Don't ship soft card elevation, large radii, or pill clusters.
Don't invent Draft timers, spectator counts, bitrate telemetry, or decorative fake Greek noise as chrome.
Don't put Lobby or Home back on a light legacy shell separate from the broadcast channel.
